lines.t: Play squads together. Rewards go to the whole squad, so each chest any of you opens is a roll for all of you.
Play Battle Royale or Zero Build. Ranked also counts.
Land at Lantern Landing for chests, or Skull Lagoon for fewer players.
Equip a Fortune Sprite. It shows nearby chests.
Open every chest on your route. Go back when chests refill.
Save long sessions for the second Treasure Hour session.
Most chests: Rubber Resort 47, Lantern Landing 45, Loguetown 41.
Route: Lantern Landing, then Arlong Park, Loguetown, Cursed Cavern.
South of Lantern Landing: the Frog Statue puzzle has 2 Rare Chests.
Fortune's Fort: the secret waterfall room has Sprite Chests and Rare Chests.
Crossbones Isle has 901 chest spawn spots. 243 always spawn a chest.
Count chests per minute. Do not skip normal chests to chase vaults.
Skull Lagoon: 32 chests and fewer players.
Buried chests sit on shorelines and sandbars: Smuggler's Sandbar and the Anchor Cove beaches.
The Chest POI holds 34 of the 62 mapped buried chests.
Arlong Park is busy. Rubber Resort is busy since the captains took it over on 15 Nov.
Jump late, away from the bus path. Loot toward the centre as the storm moves.
Do not farm bot lobbies. Nobody reports a token from them.
Chest farming: a Fortune finish. It keeps the base ability and shows nearby chests.
Chester (Epic): chance of extra chest loot, no fall damage.
Plundarrgh (Mythic): speed boost each time you open a chest.
Wayfinder (Rare): shows nearby Sprites, more Buried Chest loot.
Squads: Lil' Uzi Vert Jr. (team heal) or Transponder Snail (shared materials).
Fights: Re-Pete (best overall) or Lil' Flacko (shockwave when you land).
Cursed finish: water damages you. Do not use it near water.
No Sprite changes treasure odds. Sprites only get you to more chests.
Saturdays in the US: 2 to 4 PM and 9 to 11 PM Eastern. In Australia that is Sunday morning and Sunday afternoon.
Treasure Hours follow the Power Hours pattern Epic has used since Chapter 6 Season 3: two Saturday sessions with special modifiers. Most were 2 to 4 PM and 9 to 11 PM Eastern.
7 Nov boosts: token 1.5x in session 1 and 2x in session 2.
Boosts change each week. Read Epic's notice before you play.
A map fragment came during the 14 Nov Treasure Hours.
Token: Battle Royale and Zero Build, any team size, ranked or not.
Reload, OG and bot lobbies: not confirmed for the token.
Respawn Rumble: small prizes reported, no token yet.
Fast XP: Creative XP islands give up to 4,000,000 XP a week (50 levels). No treasure there.
Weekly quests: 20,000 XP each. New quests every Thursday 9 AM Eastern (Friday 1 AM in Sydney).
One Battle Pass level = 80,000 XP.
The season ends on 5 Dec 2026.
"Looting in the storm lowers token odds." No evidence. Epic says rates do not change during the day, except in Treasure Hours.
"The token only drops on Captain's Days." Leakers debunked it.
"New or low-skill accounts get better odds." False. Epic says every player has an equal chance.
"Datamined odds." Nothing in the game files shows the odds. Epic published 1 in 137,500.
Token compasses, finder tools and bought accounts are scams.
"Only some chest types count." Reports name Treasure, Buried, Sprite and Rare chests. Epic has not confirmed.
